section: HUD-VASH Step-by-Step: Long-Term Voucher Plus VA Case Management
text: Contact your local VA homeless program or call 1-877-4AID-VET.Complete a VA housing screen and assessment. Be honest about homelessness history, health conditions, and need for case management.If accepted, get a referral to the local housing authority for a HUD-VASH voucher.Use the voucher to lease an eligible unit. Your VA case manager stays involved for ongoing support.

section: Reasonable Accommodation Request Under the Fair Housing Act
text: 42 U.S.C.  3604(f) prohibits housing discrimination based on disability and requires landlords to grant reasonable accommodations.[36]

section: Reasonable Accommodation Request Under the Fair Housing Act
text: Sample letter: "I am a tenant at [address]. I have a disability and need the following reasonable accommodation: [reserved accessible parking space / permission for an emotional support animal / transfer to a ground-floor unit / waiver of no-pet policy]. This request is made under the Fair Housing Act, 42 U.S.C.  3604(f). I have attached [provider letter / medical documentation]. Please respond within 10 business days."
